title: Icon stands out
detail: Forest green and gold stand apart from the blue, cyan and magenta translation icons captured from competitors. The bold sparkle remains visible in the actual 16 px bitmap on a dark toolbar, though the small dot is subtle and the symbol signals AI more clearly than translation. The 128 px source artwork reaches the canvas edges (128×128 bounds); it lacks the desired centered 96×96 artwork plus 16 px transparent margin. Keep the existing extension untouched; optional padding proposal prompt is in icon/prompt.md.
